text: Before the harvest feast, Old Marek's household sent three baskets of dried plums to the house of his sister's husband. The baskets were not opened; they were stacked by the door, and in return a jar of honey was sent back the next morning.
label: GIFT_EXCHANGE

text: Lisu's mother carried a bundle of wool to the neighbouring hut. She would not say why. A month later a woven blanket appeared on our own doorstep, as if from nowhere.
label: GIFT_EXCHANGE

text: The go-between, a cousin of the groom, climbed to the widow's terrace three evenings running. On the third he left a goat tied at the gate. It was still there at dawn.
label: MARRIAGE_NEGOTIATION

text: Old women of both families sat in a ring and named the cattle each side could give. Nobody mentioned the young people.
label: MARRIAGE_NEGOTIATION

text: At the turn of the moon, the household head poured barley beer onto the flat stone behind the hearth and spoke the names of seven men no one alive had met.
label: ANCESTOR_RITUAL

text: The women sang the founder's song while climbing to the ridge shrine; the children were told to stay quiet and keep their eyes down.
label: ANCESTOR_RITUAL

text: Two brothers argued over the boundary stone for two days. On the third the eldest uncle sat between them, said nothing, and had them both drink from one bowl.
label: DISPUTE_MEDIATION

text: Ketra accused her neighbour of letting goats into the barley. The headman listened to both, then ordered a small fence built, and that was the end of it.
label: DISPUTE_MEDIATION

text: Dawn: the women carried water up from the spring in clay jars, five trips each, before the men took the goats to the high pasture.
label: EVERYDAY_LABOR

text: He spent the afternoon mending the terrace wall where the rains had washed out a section, fitting each stone by feel.
label: EVERYDAY_LABOR

text: I counted forty-two houses in the lower village and nineteen in the upper; the school has been closed since spring.
label: OTHER

text: A trader from the lowlands came through with salt and needles, and left before dark without speaking to anyone about the road.
label: OTHER
